// 01 — Projects

Homelab Builds

PROJECT // 01

Proxmox VE Cluster

Enterprise-Grade Virtualization on Consumer Hardware

Built and manage a two-node Proxmox VE cluster (OptiplexCluster) using repurposed Dell Optiplex machines. Configured Corosync for high-availability cluster communication, live VM migration between nodes, and centralized storage management. Hosts all lab VMs including OPNsense, a Windows Server instance, and various Linux services — providing a realistic enterprise virtualization environment for hands-on learning.

Proxmox VE Corosync KVM/QEMU Linux Bridges VM Migration HA Clustering
PROJECT // 02

OPNsense Firewall & Router

Software-Defined Perimeter with ISP Failover

Deployed OPNsense as a VM on Proxmox, replacing a consumer router with a full-featured enterprise firewall. Configured Gateway Groups for dual-ISP failover, ensuring automatic traffic rerouting if the primary connection drops. Implemented stateful firewall rules for inter-VLAN isolation, enforcing least-privilege access between network segments. Also tuned QoS policies to prioritize latency-sensitive traffic across the home network.

OPNsense Gateway Groups Firewall Rules QoS / Traffic Shaping ISP Failover FreeBSD
PROJECT // 03

Cisco Managed Switch & Wireless

Enterprise Switching with Cisco Mobility Express APs

Configured a Cisco Catalyst 2960 as the core layer-2 switch for the homelab, managing 802.1Q trunk ports, access port assignments per VLAN, and PortFast/BPDU Guard on edge ports. Integrated Cisco Mobility Express access points to extend wireless access per VLAN, providing segmented SSIDs for different network zones. Practiced real Cisco IOS commands directly applicable to CCNA scenarios and enterprise environments.

Cisco IOS Catalyst 2960 802.1Q Trunking PortFast / BPDU Guard Mobility Express STP
PROJECT // 04

VLAN Network Segmentation

Least-Privilege Network Design Across 3 Segments

Designed and implemented a full enterprise-style VLAN architecture across the homelab. VLAN 10 (Management) isolates infrastructure devices and Proxmox nodes. VLAN 20 (Servers) hosts VMs and lab services. VLAN 30 (IoT) sandboxes smart home devices from the rest of the network. OPNsense enforces strict inter-VLAN firewall rules, ensuring each segment can only reach what it needs — mirroring real-world least-privilege network design principles.

VLAN 10 / 20 / 30 Inter-VLAN Routing Least-Privilege 802.1Q OPNsense ACLs Network Design
